interpretations.exact_text: A calm, stately personage, with his back turned, looking from a cliff's edge at ships passing over the sea. Three staves are planted in the ground, and he leans slightly on one of them.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Wands, Three
interpretations.notes: Machine extraction seed; canonical provenance is the scan-backed Waite witness. Scan-level editorial verification is recommended for punctuation/OCR-sensitive release work.

interpretations.exact_text: He symbolizes established strength, enterprise, effort, trade, commerce, discovery; those are his ships, bearing his merchandise, which are sailing over the sea. The card also signifies able co-operation in business, as if the successful merchant prince were looking from his side towards yours with a view to help you.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Wands, Three

interpretations.exact_text: The end of troubles, suspension or cessation of adversity, toil and disappointment.
interpretations.locator: Part III, §2, The Lesser Arcana, Suit of Wands, Three
